project: Application-Oriented Network Quality Evaluation Using QoO

scenarios.name: Baseline Network
scenarios.description: Ideal clean line without intentional impairments. Establishes the ground truth empirical baseline.

scenarios.name: High Delay
scenarios.description: High fixed network latency typical of cross-continental fiber or geostationary satellite links.

scenarios.name: High Jitter
scenarios.description: Packet delay variation causing packet inter-arrival distortion, typical of congested Wi-Fi / LTE.

scenarios.name: Packet Loss
scenarios.description: Controlled packet drop rate (1.5%) triggering TCP congestion window collapse and packet retransmission.

scenarios.name: Combined Delay and Jitter
scenarios.description: Simultaneous delay (100ms) and jitter (25ms) without packet loss, isolating queuing variation.

scenarios.name: Combined Delay, Jitter and Packet Loss
scenarios.description: Compound dirty WAN environment: simultaneous latency, jitter variance, and packet loss.
